Save Last Sync Timestamp.description: Stores a string value, such as the cursor for the next incremental sync.

Store Patient Hash.description: Writes a patient's fields to a hash so other workflows can look them up quickly.

Store JSON Document.description: Saves a whole JSON object (e.g. a beneficiary record) under one key.

Store Many JSON Documents.description: Saves a batch of JSON documents in a single call.

Get String Value.description: Reads a string value by key, e.g. the last sync timestamp.
Get String Value.code:
// Read the timestamp saved by the previous run.
get('sync:dhis2:lastRun');

Get Hash Field.description: Reads a single field from a hash.

Get Whole Hash.description: Reads all fields of a hash as an object.
Get Whole Hash.code:
// Read every field of a patient hash as an object.
hGetAll(`patient:${$.data.patientId}`);

Get JSON Document.description: Reads a JSON document stored at a key.
Get JSON Document.code:
// Read a JSON document by key.
jGet(`beneficiary:${$.data.beneficiaryId}`);

Get Many JSON Documents.description: Reads JSON documents for several keys at once.

Scan Keys By Pattern.description: Finds all keys that match a glob pattern, optionally filtered by type.
